summary: Ship checksummed GitHub Release binaries, public no-Go installers, immediate Windows command resolution, and a user-owned browser-auth boundary.
reason: Normal users need a short public installation that never falls back to Go or leaves an existing Windows terminal unable to find the command, while authentication stays outside the installing agent.
validated_outcome: Public downloads, checksum and version rejection, transactional replacement, concise onboarding, and immediate Windows command resolution passed automated and Windows 11 tests.
